summary: Energy Company of Minas Gerais (CEMIG) filed a Form 6-K on June 9, 2026, reporting the election of Mr. Alexandre Ramos Peixoto as CEO on May 7, 2026, replacing Reynaldo Passanezi Filho. This is an abrupt CEO change, not routine succession, as it was resolved by the Board of Directors without prior announcement. The outgoing CEO's tenure was marked by growth and record investments. The filing also includes routine quarterly results and an acquisition notice, but the CEO change is the triggering event. Watch for strategic shifts or regulatory impacts in Brazil's power sector under new leadership.
